target.name: Method for node ranking in a linked database Abstract A method assigns importance ranks to nodes in a linked database, such as any database of documents containing citations, the world wide web or any other hypermedia database. The rank assigned to a document is calculated from the ranks of documents citing it. In addition, the rank of a document is calculated from a constant representing the probability that a browser through the database will randomly jump to the document. The method is particularly useful in enhancing the performance of search engine results for hypermedia databases, such as the world wide web, whose documents have a large variation in quality. criterion_descriptions: Evaluate whether the agent attempted to consult the Google Patents page for US6285999B1 and extract data specifically from the patent’s Info section, without switching to a different patent record. Full credit if the reported fields clearly correspond to US6285999B1 Info section. Full credit also if the agent makes a clear, good-faith attempt to access the specified record but is blocked (e.g., captcha), the page is down, or the Info section cannot be reached, and the agent explicitly reports this limitation (and does not fabricate values). Partial credit if the correct patent is used but some information appears drawn from outside the Info section or the source is ambiguous. No credit if another patent record is used or the agent fabricates values while claiming they come from the Info section.

Provide the patent title exactly as shown in the Info section. Full credit if exact, or if the agent states the title is not displayed/accessible in the Info section due to page/UI access limitations after attempting to view it (without guessing). Partial credit if minor transcription error that does not change meaning. No credit if missing without explanation when accessible, clearly incorrect, or fabricated.

Provide the publication number exactly as shown in the Info section (including kind code). Full credit if exact, or if the agent states it is not displayed/accessible due to access/UI limitations after attempting to view it (without guessing). Partial credit if missing kind code or minor formatting issue. No credit if wrong identifier, fabricated, or missing without explanation when accessible.

Provide the application number exactly as shown in the Info section. Full credit if exact, or if the agent states it is not displayed/accessible due to access/UI limitations after attempting to view it (without guessing). Partial credit if minor formatting differences. No credit if missing without explanation when accessible, wrong, or fabricated.

Provide the inventor name(s) exactly as listed in the Info section. Full credit if all inventors are included and spelled exactly as displayed, or if the agent states the inventor field is not displayed/accessible due to access/UI limitations after attempting to view it (without guessing). Partial credit if one inventor is missing or minor spelling error. No credit if omitted without explanation when accessible, incorrect person(s) listed, or fabricated.

List every current assignee shown in the Info section, preserving names exactly and keeping this field separate from original assignee. Full credit if all current assignees are included with exact wording and not merged with original assignee, or if the agent states the current assignee field is not displayed/accessible due to access/UI limitations after attempting to view it (without guessing). Partial credit if one current assignee is missing, there is a minor transcription error, or separation from original assignee is unclear. No credit if wrong/omitted without explanation when accessible, conflated with original assignee, or fabricated.

Provide the original assignee exactly as listed in the Info section, distinct from current assignee(s). Full credit if exact and clearly separated, or if the agent states the original assignee field is not displayed/accessible due to access/UI limitations after attempting to view it (without guessing). Partial credit if minor transcription error or separation is unclear. No credit if omitted without explanation when accessible, incorrect, conflated, or fabricated.

Provide the priority date exactly as shown in the Info section. Full credit if exact, or if the agent states the priority date is not displayed/accessible due to access/UI limitations after attempting to view it (without guessing). Partial credit if date formatting differs from display. No credit if missing without explanation when accessible, wrong, or fabricated.

Provide the filing date exactly as shown in the Info section. Full credit if exact, or if the agent states the filing date is not displayed/accessible due to access/UI limitations after attempting to view it (without guessing). Partial credit if date formatting differs from display. No credit if missing without explanation when accessible, wrong, or fabricated.

Provide the publication date exactly as shown in the Info section. Full credit if exact, or if the agent states the publication date is not displayed/accessible due to access/UI limitations after attempting to view it (without guessing). Partial credit if date formatting differs from display. No credit if missing without explanation when accessible, wrong, or fabricated.

Provide the legal status wording exactly as displayed in the Info section (verbatim phrasing). Full credit if exact, or if the agent states the legal status is not displayed/accessible due to access/UI limitations after attempting to view it (without guessing). Partial credit if meaning is preserved but phrasing deviates. No credit if omitted without explanation when accessible, guessed, or fabricated.

Assess whether the agent stops once all requested fields are captured from the Info section (or clearly reports which requested Info fields are not displayed/accessible), without adding significant extra fields or content beyond the requested set. Full credit if it stops at the requested endpoint and does not use disallowed sources (PDF/external patent-office links). Partial credit if minor extra, non-intrusive content is added but all required fields are still present. No credit if it relies on disallowed sources, adds substantial extraneous content, or continues beyond the requested stopping condition in a way that violates instructions.
